title: Bicycle
source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 3 READING 본문 — Bicycle
body_text: Mt. Tambora, a volcano in Indonesia, exploded in 1815. The explosion created a huge cloud of ash, so crops failed around the world. As a result, people didn’t have enough food to eat. Surprisingly, this made traveling difficult. Why? In those days, people rode horses, but many horses were killed for food. People needed a new way to travel, and Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle in Germany in 1817. Drais’s bicycle had two wooden wheels but no pedals. How did it move without pedals? Well, riders simply pushed the bicycle forward with their feet. The present-day bicycle is the result of many inventors’ work in the 19th century.
